function_id.description: Identifier of the target function (e.g., function_01)

system_variant.description: Which experimental system generated this run

iteration_count.description: Number of Proposed refinement rounds actually executed (0 when the initial suite already kills all mutants; baselines may use 1 for their single generation pass). Maximum 5.

total_tokens_used.description: Total prompt + completion tokens used across iterations

num_llm_calls.description: Total LLM calls used for this run, including initial generation and refinement calls.

pass_rate_pct.description: Percentage of generated tests that pass against the original unmutated code.

branch_coverage_pct.description: Final branch coverage percentage when branch coverage is available.

initial_mutation_score_pct.description: Mutation score before the first refinement round; Proposed only.

stop_reason.description: Why the Proposed refinement loop stopped.

provider.description: LLM provider used for this run.

model.description: Exact model identifier used for this run.
